shared_elements: rows of small repeated signs/strokes arranged horizontally
schematic human-derived figures (standing figures in A, crew strokes in B)
quadruped animal (indistinctly in A's upper scene; clearly in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry rows of small repeated marks arranged in horizontal bands and some figural element alongside them, a feature almost any inscribed or marked rock surface could produce independently. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by a single large schematic boat with a serried row of crew strokes and upturned prow/stern, a motif entirely absent from A, which instead shows dense columnar text with large modelled standing figures below.
